about.title: Game da Proud Muslim
about.description: Taimaka wa Musulmi a duniya da ingantattun lokutan salla, nazarin Alƙur'ani, sahihan azkar, da kayan aikin Musulunci.
about.purposeText1: Proud Muslim app ne mai haɗa kayan aikin Musulunci da aka tsara don taimaka wa Musulmi a ibadarsu ta yau da kullum, karatun Alƙur'ani, salla a kan lokaci, da ilimin Musulunci, tare da fuskar amfani mai tsafta da mutunci.
about.purposeText2: Muna fifita sirri, daidaito, sauƙin amfani ga kowa, da girmama al'adun Musulunci yayin amfani da fasahar wayar hannu ta zamani.
about.featuresIntro: Proud Muslim yana samar da kayan aikin Musulunci masu yawa na yau da kullum, ciki har da:
about.feature1: Ingantattun lokutan salla tare da hanyoyin lissafi na duniya da sanarwar kiran salla da za a iya keɓancewa.
about.feature2: Mai gano alƙibla ta amfani da kamfas da na'urorin GPS na wayar.
about.feature3: Cikakken Alƙur'ani mai girma tare da fassarori a harsuna da yawa, haskaka kalma bayan kalma, da karatun sauti.
about.feature4: Sunayen Allah 99 (Asma-ul-Husna) tare da furuci na sauti, ma'anoni, da cikakkun bayanai.
about.feature5: Azkar da addu'o'in Hisnul Muslim, da ma'aunin tasbihi na dijital don zikiri na yau da kullum.
about.feature6: Kalandar Hijira ta Musulunci, lissafin zakka, da kayan gano masallatan al'umma.
about.freeForeverHeading: 3. Alƙawarin muhimman abubuwa su kasance kyauta har abada
about.freeForeverNotice: Alƙawari: Rubutun Alƙur'ani mai girma, Sunayen Allah 99, da muhimman kiran salla za su kasance 100% a buɗe ga kowane mai amfani har abada.
about.freeForeverText: Mun yi imani sosai cewa muhimman kayan ibadar Musulunci ya kamata su kasance kyauta. Ba za a taɓa toshe karatun Alƙur'ani na asali, sautin kiran salla, da nazarin Asma-ul-Husna ta hanyar wajabta biyan kuɗi ba.
about.developerText: ANM Digital Labs ne ke haɓakawa, wallafawa, da kula da Proud Muslim. Mun sadaukar da kanmu wajen ƙirƙirar manhajoji da kayan dijital masu inganci waɗanda ke girmama sirri ga al'ummar Musulmi ta duniya.
about.limitationsText: Proud Muslim kayan taimako ne na bayani da fasaha. Ba ya bayar da fatawar addini, maye gurbin ƙwararrun malaman Musulunci, ko maye gurbin hukumomin masallaci na gida. Ya kamata masu amfani su riƙa tuntuɓar ƙwararrun malamai kan muhimman hukuncin fiƙihu da addini.

privacyTerms.permLocation: Wuri: Ana amfani da shi kawai don lissafin lokutan salla da alkiblar kamfas.

privacyTerms.retentionText: Saitunan gida suna kasancewa a na'urarka har sai ka share bayanan app ko ka cire app. Ana riƙe imel na taimako kawai na tsawon lokacin da ake buƙata don warware tambayoyi.

privacyTerms.childrenText: An tsara Proud Muslim don jama'a gaba ɗaya kuma ba ya tattara bayanan sirri daga yara ƙasa da shekara 13 (ko shekarun da dokar gida ta tanada) da saninsa. Iyaye su kula da izinin na'ura.

privacyTerms.termsNotice: Waɗannan Sharuɗɗan amfani suna tafiyar da damar shiga da amfani da app ɗin Proud Muslim da sabis ɗinsa masu alaƙa.

privacyTerms.availabilityText: Muna iya sabuntawa, gyarawa, ko dakatar da fasaloli don inganta ƙwarewar mai amfani. Ba ma ba da tabbacin samuwa ba tare da yankewa ba.

disclaimer.title: Sanarwar rashin ɗaukar alhaki da Iyakoki
disclaimer.description: Muhimman bayanai game da lokutan salla, kamfas ɗin alƙibla, fassarori, da shawarar addini.
disclaimer.centralNotice: Sanarwa: Proud Muslim kayan ibada ne na bayani da fasaha. Ba ya maye gurbin ƙwararrun malaman Musulunci, hukumomin addini na gida, ko lura da taurari kai tsaye.
disclaimer.prayerTimesText: Ana lissafin lokutan salla ta hanyoyin ilimin taurari da aka sani (misali, Diyanet, MWL, ISNA, Umm al-Qura). Bambanci na iya tasowa saboda tsayin wuri, karkatar haske a sararin samaniya, yanayin ƙananan yankuna, da tsarin masallatan gida. Koyaushe bi kiran sallar masallacin yankinka idan akwai.
disclaimer.qiblaText: Kamfas ɗin alƙibla na dijital ya dogara da na'urar auna maganadisu ta cikin wayarka da daidaiton GPS. Tsangwamar lantarki da maganadisu, murfin ƙarfe, da na'urorin da ba a daidaita ba na iya karkatar da alkibla. Koyaushe daidaita kamfas ta motsa wayarka a siffar lamba 8.
disclaimer.hijriText: Ranaku na Hijira suna dogara da matakan wata da aka lissafa ta ilimin taurari. Ainihin watannin Musulunci da bukukuwan addini (Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha) suna dogara da sanarwar ganin wata ta gida da hukumomin addini na yanki suka tabbatar.
disclaimer.quranText: Alƙur'ani na asali shi ne rubutun Larabci kawai da aka saukar wa Annabi Muhammad (tsira da amincin Allah su tabbata a gare shi). Duk fassarori a Turanci, Turkanci, Urdu, Jamusanci, da sauransu, fassarar ma'anoni ce ta ɗan adam kuma ba za su iya ƙunsar cikakken zurfin harshen wahayi na Larabci ba.
disclaimer.zakatHeading: 5. Sanarwar rashin ɗaukar alhaki na lissafin zakka
disclaimer.zakatText: Kayan zakka yana samar da lissafi gaba ɗaya bisa ƙimomin da mai amfani ya shigar da ma'aunin nisabi na yau da kullum. A tattauna rikitattun yanayin kuɗi, kayan kasuwanci, da wasu wajibcin bashi da ƙwararren malamin harkokin kuɗin Musulunci.
disclaimer.notificationsText: Tsarin aiki na na'ura, yanayin rage cin batir, saitunan Kada a dame ni, da iyakokin ayyukan baya na OEM na iya jinkirta ko hana sanarwar kiran salla. Ana shawartar masu amfani kada su dogara kawai da sanarwar wayar hannu wajen wajibcin da lokaci yake da muhimmanci.
disclaimer.scholarsHeading: 7. Ba ya maye gurbin malaman Musulunci
disclaimer.scholarsText: Babu wani abun ciki a Proud Muslim da yake fatawar hukuma. Don fiƙihu na mutum, dokar iyali, ko rikicin addini, tuntuɓi malaman Musulunci da aka amince da su da cibiyoyi masu iko a al'ummarka.

datasets.pageTitle: Tarin bayanai da Tushen abun ciki
datasets.title: Tarin bayanai da Tushen abun ciki
datasets.description: Bayani a fili na duk rubutun Alƙur'ani, fassarori, lissafin salla, da tushen sauti.
datasets.introNotice: Mun yi imani da cikakken bayani a fili game da tushen bayanai. A ƙasa akwai cikakken jerin tarin bayanan dijital da Proud Muslim yake amfani da su.
datasets.quranTableDesc: Fayilolin rubutun Alƙur'ani a harsuna da yawa, masu fassara, masu bayar da lasisi, da hanyoyin shiga:
datasets.prayerHeading: 2. Hanyoyin lissafin salla da Tushen ilimin taurari
datasets.prayerText: Hanyoyin lissafin da aka tallafa sun haɗa da Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı (Turkey), Muslim World League (MWL), Islamic Society of North America (ISNA), Umm al-Qura University (Makkah), Egyptian General Authority of Survey, University of Islamic Sciences (Karachi), da ƙa'idodin yankin Gulf.
datasets.hadithText: Ana samo azkar, addu'o'in safe/yamma, da addu'o'in yau da kullum daga Hisnul Muslim (Garkuwar Musulmi) na Saeed bin Ali bin Wahf Al-Qahtani, kuma an tabbatar da su bisa sahihan ruwayoyin Sahih al-Bukhari da Sahih Muslim.
datasets.audioHeading: 4. Tushen sauti da Kafofin watsa labarai
datasets.audioText: Proud Muslim yanzu yana yaɗa karatun Alƙur'ani na Mishary Rashid Alafasy (bugu ar.alafasy) daga Al Quran Cloud audio CDN da Islamic Network ke gudanarwa. Haƙƙin mallaka yana nan ga mai karatu ko mai haƙƙin da ya dace.
datasets.verificationNotice: Manufar tabbatarwa: Ba ma ƙirƙirar tushen bayanai ko lasisi. Ana kwatanta duk bayanan tarin bayanai da masu kula da tushen asali. Idan an gano saɓani, ana duba shi da gyara cikin gaggawa.
datasets.statusPublicAccess: Damar shiga ta jama'a da aka tabbatar
datasets.statusVerifiedEducational: Amfani na ilimi da aka tabbatar

websites.verifiedHeading: 1. Kadarorin yanar gizo na hukuma da aka tabbatar
websites.verifiedIntro: Amince kawai da bayanai, abubuwan saukewa, da sanarwar da aka wallafa a sunayen yankin intanet ɗinmu da aka tabbatar:
websites.site1Title: Shafin yanar gizo na hukuma na Proud Muslim
websites.site1Desc: Babban shafi don bayanin app, taƙaitaccen fasaloli, da hanyoyin sauke app ɗin wayar hannu na hukuma.
websites.site2Desc: Shafin mai haɓakawa da wallafawa na hukuma don ayyukan manhajar ANM Digital Labs.
websites.site3Desc: Ma'ajiyar hukuma don manufofin sirri, sharuɗɗan amfani, lasisi, da tarin bayanan abun ciki.
websites.site4Desc: Ma'ajiyar buɗaɗɗiyar lamba ta hukuma, takardun jama'a, da albarkatun masu haɓakawa.
websites.securityHeading: 2. Gargaɗin tsaro da Hana satar bayanai ta yaudara
websites.securityText: Yi hattara da shafukan yanar gizo na zamba, app na jabu, ko asusun kafofin sada zumunta da ba na hukuma ba da ke da'awar wakiltar Proud Muslim. Ba za mu taɓa neman bayanan shiga biyan kuɗinka, PIN na katin kuɗi, ko kalmomin sirrinka ta imel ko shafukan waje ba.

support.attributionText: Idan kana wakiltar marubucin abun ciki ko mai fassara kuma kana son sabunta bayanin mai haƙƙi, aika imel zuwa info@anmdigital.online da takardun da suka dace.
support.securityWarningText: Kada ka aika kalmomin sirri, bayanan katin banki, bayanan biyan kuɗi, ko lambobin shaidar gwamnati ta imel. Ƙungiyarmu ba za ta taɓa neman sirrin kuɗi ko na tabbatar da shaida ba.

translationNotice.title: Sanarwar fassara
translationNotice.independence: Proud Muslim app ne mai zaman kansa, ba cibiyar Musulunci ba ne kuma ba hukuma ta addini ba ce. Fassarar Alƙur'ani tana bayyana fahimtar ɗan adam ga ma'anonin rubutun Larabci na asali kuma tana iya ƙunsar kurakurai, abubuwan da aka bari, ko bambancin fahimta.
translationNotice.responsibility: Ana danganta fassarori ga masu fassararsu da masu wallafarsu. Proud Muslim ba ya da'awar tabbatar da daidaitonsu na addini ko harshe da kansa. Gwargwadon abin da dokar da ta dace ta yarda, ba mu yarda da alhakin kurakuran da suka samo asali daga fassarar ɓangare na uku ba. Wannan ba ya cire alhakin da ba za a iya cirewa bisa doka ba, ciki har da alhakin kurakuran da sarrafawarmu ta haifar.
translationNotice.guidance: Don tambayoyin fahimtar addini, tuntuɓi ƙwararren malami. Ka sanar da kurakuran da kake zargi ta bayanan tushen fassarar ko hanyar taimako ta app da ake da ita.
translationNotice.report: Sanar da kuskuren fassara da ake zargi

legalTranslationNotice.title: Sanarwar fassarar takardun doka
legalTranslationNotice.text: Ana samar da waɗannan takardun doka a fassara domin sauƙaƙa samun su. Fassara na iya ƙunsar kurakurai, abubuwan da aka bari, ko bambancin kalmomi. Proud Muslim ba ya tabbatar da daidaitonsu na doka ko harshe da kansa. Idan kalmomi sun bambanta ko ba su bayyana ba, duba tushen Turanci kuma tuntuɓi info@anmdigital.online don bayani. Wannan sanarwa ba ta iyakance haƙƙoƙi ko alhakin da ba za a iya cirewa bisa doka ba, ciki har da alhakin kurakuran da sarrafawarmu ta haifar.

developerSupport.title: Tallafa wa mai haɓakawa
developerSupport.description: Ana haɓakawa da kula da Proud Muslim da kansa. Idan app yana amfaninka kuma kana son tallafa wa ci gaban haɓakarsa, za ka iya bayar da gudummawa da son ranka.
developerSupport.contributionsText: Tallafa wa mai haɓakawa zaɓi ne gaba ɗaya. Za ka iya zaɓar bayar da gudummawa ta shafin tallafi na waje na hukuma da aka haɗa a ƙasa.
developerSupport.notice: Gudummawa ba ta buɗe fasalolin Premium, abun ciki na dijital, rajista, ƙarin aiki, ko fifikon kulawa a cikin Proud Muslim.
developerSupport.purchasesHeading: Ya bambanta da sayayyar Google Play
developerSupport.purchasesText: Tallafin son rai ga mai haɓakawa ya bambanta da rajistar Proud Muslim Premium da sayayyar da Google Play ke sarrafawa. Damar Premium, gwaji, sabunta rajista, sokewa, dawo da sayayya, da mayar da kuɗi suna ci gaba da kasancewa ƙarƙashin tsarin sayayyar Google Play da ya dace da wallafaffun sharuɗɗan Proud Muslim.
developerSupport.goodsHeading: Babu kayan dijital a madadin gudummawa
developerSupport.goodsText: Gudummawa ba biyan kuɗin kayan dijital ko sabis a cikin app ba ce. Ba a bayar da haƙƙin Premium, damar abun ciki, kuɗin cikin app, lokacin rajista, damar fasali, ko wata fa'idar dijital a madadin gudummawa.
developerSupport.paymentHeading: Biyan kuɗi na waje mai tsaro
developerSupport.paymentText: Stripe ne ke sarrafa gudummawa a wajen app ɗin Proud Muslim. Proud Muslim ba ya tattarawa ko adana cikakkun bayanan katin biyan kuɗinka a wannan shafin doka.
developerSupport.questionsBefore: Ana iya miƙa tambayoyin gudummawar son rai ta rasidin mai samar da biyan kuɗi ko tsarin warware mu'amala, ko zuwa
developerSupport.questionsAfter: Buƙatun mayar da kuɗin Google Play don rajistar app ko sayayya sun bambanta da gudummawar son rai.
